unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: They have got a new car.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: have got 就像随身背着（got）一个包，表示“拥有”。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: You can use have or have got for possession.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 双写 s 的 pos-ses-sion，牢牢占有（possess）不放。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: You can use have or have got for relationships.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: relation（关系）+ ship（船/状态后缀）= 人际关系之船。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: You can use have or have got for illnesses.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: ill（生病的）加名词后缀 -ness 变成“疾病”。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: You can use have or have got for appointments.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: appoint（指定时间）+ ment = 预约。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: We do not use continuous forms.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: con（共同）+ tin（持续）+ uous，一直连绵不断。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Sometimes I have a sandwich for my breakfast.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: break（打破）+ fast（斋戒/禁食）= 早餐（打破昨晚以来的禁食）。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Check the objects and collocations in the table.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: col（共同）+ locate（放置）= 词语放在一起的“搭配”。
ac + cident，出门不小心（accident）出了事故。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: James has got a lot of experience.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: ex（出）+ peri（尝试）+ ence，经历过才能有经验。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: You can have a conversation with somebody.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: con（共同）+ vers（转）+ ation，大家转着圈说话聊天。
